desc: Boot 5019's object as the standalone NVMe desktop entry, CJ present. CJ copies the object to the linux partition and enrolls it in 1TR with kmutil (NEXT_STEPS manual commands); the m1n1 DebugUSB rollback volume stays enrolled. Before shutdown from the old kernel: write_cache = write through, clean reboot/poweroff only. PASS: OpenRC + i3 up, Norwegian layout, WiFi joins, keyboard/trackpad, uname -r and Image hash match 5019; /dev/uhid present and the MX Ergo S bonded mouse appears as an input device; /sys/kernel/tracing usable; /sys/fs/pstore mounted and ramoops registered at the 5019 region; exFAT and ext4 clean on the next boot after a clean reboot. Then one deliberate warm-reboot pstore check: echo a marker to /dev/pmsg0, clean reboot, marker present in /sys/fs/pstore. STOP: no console/desktop, SError/panic, dirty exFAT after a clean reboot, any write outside p3. Rollback: boot the m1n1 rollback entry or re-enroll 5014 (6a522d64). Do not pair the Dygma Defy.
author: claude
